purpose: Give an upper limit that is modest or less than expected.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
There will probably be ten participants at most.
Even on foot, it takes at most fifteen minutes.
The most I can do is gather materials.
restrictions: May imply disappointment; distinguish from its encouragement use with effort verbs.
mistake: せいぜい十人 means ten at most, not at least ten.

segments.role: Give an upper limit that is modest or less than expected. せいぜい + amount / limit
